en: The Octave on Ardhanārīśvara.
To her whose locks of hair are dark as rain-clouds;
to him who wears matted locks tawny with the luster of lightning;
to her who is without a lord; to him who is the lord of all.
Salutations to Śivā and salutations to Śiva. || 1 ||
To her whose earrings blaze with radiant jewels, who is adorned with shimmering great serpents,
and who is the beloved of Śiva— to her and to the beloved of Śiva.
Salutation to Śivā and salutation to Śiva. || 2 ||
To her whose locks are adorned with garlands of mandāra flowers, whose neck is marked by a garland of skulls,
who wears divine garments, and who is clad in the directions as her raiment.
Salutation to Śivā and salutation to Śiva. || 3 ||
To her who has applied musk and saffron for anointing,
and who has smeared herself with the ashes of the cremation ground;
to her who has mastered passion, and to him whose passion is transformed.
Salutations to Śivā and salutations to Śiva. || 4 ||
To the one who has offered his swan-like body at the lotus-feet, whose silver anklets are serpent-kings upon his lotus-feet,
who consists of all arts yet is free from all defects.
Salutations to Śivā and salutations to Śiva. || 5 ||
To her whose body is intent on the dance of the creation of phenomenal proliferation, to him who performs the *tāṇḍava* of universal dissolution;
to her who possesses even eyes, to him who possesses uneven eyes.
Salutation to Śivā and salutation to Śiva. || 6 ||
To her whose eyes are like blossoming blue lotuses,
to her whose eyes are like blooming lotuses,
to the mother of the world, and to the sole father of the world.
Homage to Śivā and homage to Śiva.

To her who has gone everywhere— within and without, above and below, in the middle, in front and behind, in the intermediate directions and the cardinal points— to her who has gone to all things, to the All.
Salutation to Śivā and salutation to Śiva. || 8 ||
This *Ardhanārīśvarastotra*, composed by Upamanyu, is such that whoever recites it or even hears it is glorified in the world of Śiva. || 9 ||
Thus ends the *Ardhanārīśvarāṣṭaka* composed by Upamanyu.
